answer: Anchor each agent identity to a verifiable chain of completed work: an agent must present attestations from prior transactions before joining a market. A terrace of escalating reputation levels means newcomers start with tiny limits and earn larger ones only after honest activity. A fake identity is a relic with no history — it cannot fabricate the attested past others rely on, so creating thousands of cheap copies buys no trust, while genuine agents keep the record that proves them.
